message: Here are 5 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Overhead reaching from stepladder
hazards.description: A worker standing on the orange fiberglass stepladder at right center is reaching fully overhead with an extended arm toward the overhead pipe, which raises the risk of losing balance and falling from the ladder.

hazards.title: Pinch points during flange work
hazards.description: Two workers at center-left are handling a large blue pipe flange assembly by hand, putting their hands and fingers at risk of being caught between heavy pipe components.

hazards.title: Gas cylinder beside doorway
hazards.description: A chained compressed gas cylinder with a regulator attached stands right next to the doorway at right, where it could be struck by passing carts or pallet jacks.

hazards.title: Pallet and fittings on floor
hazards.description: A low pallet loaded with pipe fittings and a cordless drill sits on the floor beside the tool cart at left, creating a trip hazard in the work area.

hazards.title: Cluttered tool cart and work area
hazards.description: The tool cart at far left is crowded with tools and parts, and loose items sit around the concrete pipe base, reducing order in the work area.
